hero.title: Open science profiles and public research surfaces
hero.description: A unified index of public research identities, repositories, and data platforms used to share reproducible scholarship, datasets, and engineering artifacts.

commitment.title: Commitment to Open Science
commitment.description: Open science in this portfolio means persistent identifiers, transparent publication records, accessible datasets, and cross-linked engineering artifacts that can be validated and reused.
principles: Prioritize DOI-backed and publicly verifiable scholarly artifacts.
Connect publications, datasets, and repositories through traceable links.
Maintain transparent evidence pathways across research and implementation outputs.
